integrity: The mathematical result is supported by a combinatorial proof and reproducible exact finite enumeration. Finite enumeration is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Uniform unweighted derangements only; exact finite covariance spectrum, not a central limit theorem or weighted generalization. Published unrestricted rook counts supply inputs; historical priority of the spectral law is not independently certified.
title: The complete covariance spectrum of uniform derangement assignment scores
